scope: Frozen first C2 external acceptance suite against supplied public C2 rules and original baseline; not an application assessment or launch approval.

reviewer.independence: Different model from the claimed GLM constructor; no family independence claimed. No models or subagents invoked.

blocking_findings.summary: UI tie test requires the newest timestamp pair to lead both ascending and descending orders, contradicting the disclosed comparator.
CRUD checks assume sequential create and edit times strictly increase; valid equal timestamps must use ID tie directions.
Bounded same-millisecond burst ties are not guaranteed by the public API; setup failure is reported as a candidate failure.
Tests require native select/option markup and a region role although rules specify an accessible selector and named list.
Auth tests assert pending native error code/status and an undocumented 127.0.0.1 HTTP origin pattern.
Report validator accepts one-case and failed-case reports, checks neither exact identities/projects nor freshness, and zero test skips does not establish all assertions ran.
UI request counts are not attributed to each selection and do not verify request sort or response use; incidental GET plus client-only reorder can pass.
Several claimed required failing case IDs do not follow from their stated patch variants, notably BINARY on all-uppercase-initial seed titles and optional ownership/precedence/persistence variants.

Registered external replay interface and project names not supplied; direct script mode is 0400 in delivered inputs; regex scanning and npx alone do not establish trusted dependency/import or hash binding.
No supplied evidence of conforming reference/alternative pass, actual bad-patch qualification, three clean replays, or registered external-replay qualification.

optional_findings.summary: Non-ASCII NOCASE and digit-bearing natural-order distinctions are not covered.
URL and storage absence is checked only with literal sort= and reload outcome.
Earlier freeze timing, constructor prompt, independently executed baseline regressions and per-run 3/4 report identity are not established by supplied records.
Probe cleanup reuses and purges named disposable workspaces and is best effort; isolation and serial execution are operational prerequisites.
Empty sort, duplicate parameters and initial selector state need uniform public interpretation where applicable, not target-dependent oracle repair.

verified.report_project: one unnamed default project per report; browserName chromium set in configs
verified.baseline_run: constructor-supplied run-5 baseline report and log corroborate expected failure counts; not independently rerun
verified.input_hash_manifest: output/c2-review/SHA256SUMS; input file paths are relative to /workspace

not_verified: constructor prompt or earlier freeze snapshots
